Hi Samira,

Thanks again for agreeing to participate in a case study — we really appreciate PioneerEdu letting us highlight the work you've done with Redwood. I want to schedule a ~45-minute discovery interview with your team to capture use cases, outcomes, and any product screenshots you’re comfortable sharing.

Suggested high-level agenda (attached as a short PDF):
- 5 min: intros + purpose
- 10 min: product background & integration flow
- 15 min: outcomes/metrics and customer stories
- 10 min: open feedback & closing

Logistics/questions:
- Recording: we record these calls for accuracy and transcription. We’ll send a draft write-up and recording for approval before publishing — is that okay?
- Participants: who from PioneerEdu should join (engineering, CS, marketing)?
- Times: I’m available Thu 5/6 10–12 PT or Fri 5/7 9–11 PT; I can also send a calendar poll if those don't work.

Attachments: case-study-prep-agenda.pdf (short agenda), redwood-reference-guidelines.docx (publishing + logo usage).

If helpful, I can include Marissa (CS lead) and Connor (solutions) on the call — looping them here.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
